task.title: Use Guided fine-tuning controls
task.shortdesc: Expand fine-tuning and advanced controls deliberately after the baseline choices are clear.

prereq.p: A Guided profile draft has a scenario, preset, or initial settings.

context.p: Fine-tuning lets you reach advanced controls without abandoning the task-first Guided workflow.

step.cmd: Open the step that owns the control family you need.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Expand the fine-tuning or advanced area for that family.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Change only the setting needed for the profile goal.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Recheck the plain-language summary and validation message before continuing.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: The profile contains deliberate advanced changes rather than accidental broad edits.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the change is hard to explain, reset the control and use All settings or JSON editor for deeper inspection.
